name: @brainstorm/harness
description: Brainstorm harness hub — dogfood sessions, the dev MCP server, and orchestration. Drives the sibling shell repo at ../shell.

scripts.dogfood:build: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm-os/shell build && bun run build:apps)
scripts.dogfood:catalog: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm-os/shell build && bun run build:apps) && playwright test --config=playwright.catalog.config.ts
scripts.dogfood:backup: mkdir -p tests/dogfood/.data-backups && tar --exclude=Cache --exclude='Code Cache' --exclude=GPUCache --exclude=DawnGraphiteCache --exclude=DawnWebGPUCache --exclude=Crashpad --exclude=blob_storage -czf tests/dogfood/.data-backups/northbound-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).tar.gz -C tests/dogfood .data && ls -lh tests/dogfood/.data-backups/
scripts.promo:capture: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm-os/shell build) && playwright test --config=playwright.promo.config.ts promo.spec
scripts.promo:capture:notes: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm-os/shell build) && playwright test --config=playwright.promo.config.ts vid-notes
scripts.promo:render:notes: PROMO_SCENES=./notes-scenes.mjs PROMO_DIR=.promo-notes PROMO_OUT=vid-notes PROMO_MUSIC=tools/promo/assets/vid-notes-music.mp3 PROMO_VO_GAIN=2.7 PROMO_MUSIC_GAIN=0.32 node tools/promo/render.mjs
scripts.promo:capture:agent: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm-os/shell build) && BRAINSTORM_DEMO_AGENT=1 playwright test --config=playwright.promo.config.ts vid-agent-team
scripts.promo:render:agent: PROMO_SCENES=./agent-team-scenes.mjs PROMO_DIR=.promo-agent PROMO_OUT=vid-agent-team PROMO_MUSIC=tools/promo/assets/vid-notes-music.mp3 PROMO_VO_GAIN=2.7 PROMO_MUSIC_GAIN=0.32 node tools/promo/render.mjs
scripts.promo:capture:build-apps: (cd ../shell && bun run --filter @brainstorm-os/shell build) && BRAINSTORM_DEMO_AGENT=appforge playwright test --config=playwright.promo.config.ts vid-build-apps
scripts.promo:render:build-apps: PROMO_SCENES=./build-apps-scenes.mjs PROMO_DIR=.promo-build-apps PROMO_OUT=vid-build-apps PROMO_MUSIC=tools/promo/assets/vid-notes-music.mp3 PROMO_VO_GAIN=2.7 PROMO_MUSIC_GAIN=0.32 node tools/promo/render.mjs
